postings.title: Applied AI Engineer (m/w/d)
postings.description: Build LLM-powered features for our logistics platform in Berlin. You will own the full lifecycle of applied machine learning systems, from prototyping with Python and PyTorch to production deployment on Kubernetes. You work closely with product managers, designers and our customers to turn ambiguous problems into reliable software. We are looking for someone with strong engineering fundamentals and a passion for shipping. Fließende Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Salary range EUR 85,000 - 105,000 plus equity. Unbefristete Festanstellung, hybrid with three days in the office.

postings.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
postings.description: Work with enterprise customers to deploy agent systems into their environments. You will scope projects, write integration code, run workshops and be the technical point of contact for our largest accounts. Strong communication skills, experience with Python and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, and the ability to travel up to twenty percent are required. German C1 is required for customer workshops in Munich. Hybrid, three days in the office.

postings.title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
postings.description: Design and maintain data pipelines that feed our machine learning models. You will work with Spark, Airflow and cloud storage, and you will help define data quality standards across the platform team. Experience with SQL and Python is important, and so is a pragmatic approach to reliability and monitoring in production systems that serve thousands of requests every day.
